common.fallbackNotice: Albanian is not populated yet — showing English.

auth.noAccessTitle: This account has no access to MG2030
auth.noAccessBody: You are signed in, but this account is not registered on the MG2030 platform. It may belong to another application hosted on the same infrastructure. If you believe this is a mistake, contact the project coordinator.
auth.pendingBody: Your MG2030 account exists but has not been activated yet. An administrator must approve it before you can see project data.
auth.invitationOnly: Accounts are created by the project administrator. There is no self sign-up.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this item.

demo.title: Design system
demo.intro: Every primitive of the MG2030 interface, in each of its states. This page exists so the charter can be reviewed without opening a feature screen.
demo.tokensIntro: Single source: lib/tokens.ts. No colour is written by hand anywhere else.
demo.brandPalette: Institutional palette — emblem of the Republic of Kosovo
demo.accent2Note: Emblem border and map of Kosovo
demo.buttonsIntro: Four variants. The accent carries the primary action; --danger is reserved for destructive ones.
demo.loadingNote: The label is replaced and the button becomes disabled. No spinner.
demo.fieldsIntro: Focus ring in forms, border only in table cells. The field-level error style did not exist in the charter repository: it is added here.
demo.fieldErrorHint: Leaving the field empty triggers the error.
demo.cellNote: A ring would spill over neighbouring cells, so only the border is used.
demo.containersIntro: A surface sitting in the flow has no shadow, only a border. Shadows are reserved for what floats above.
demo.cardNote: Everyday container: framed table, panel, page block. 8 px radius, 1 px border, no shadow.
demo.panelNote: Full-page card: sign-in, access-denied screen. 12 px radius, 32 px padding, light shadow.
demo.okNoteLong: Positive action — never the accent, which would read as a signal
demo.statusesIntro: Pastel palette taken from the charter repository. The « late » red is deliberately mild and distinct from --danger.
demo.tablesIntro: List table, light header. The dark-header summary table and the editable grid ship with the modules that use them.
demo.formatsIntro: Dates as dd/mm/yyyy in both languages, amounts in euros excluding tax, durations in calendar days.
demo.planDateWhy: Calendar day, no time zone: no risk of a one-day shift
demo.amountWhy: The « excl. VAT » suffix prevents reading tax-inclusive figures where the seed is tax-exclusive
demo.rangeWhy: Works lots carry bounds, not a single value
demo.missingWhy: Never 0 nor an empty string: missing data must be visible
demo.i18nIntro: No hard-coded string, from the very first component (brief §6).
demo.fallbackExplain: Albanian is out of scope for version 1 (brief §9): the infrastructure is ready, the dictionary is still to be validated by the PIU. Any missing key falls back to English — that is the expected behaviour, not a failure.

home.progressIntro: The consolidated dashboard is out of scope for version 1 (brief §9). This page stands in for it until the first feature module ships.
home.designSystemIntro: Every primitive of the interface, in each of its states.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Around 30 accounts, all internal, created by invitation. There is no self sign-up (brief §3).
users.name: Name
users.sharedAuthWarning: Warning — the authentication pool is shared with another application on the same Supabase project. Being signed in does not grant access to MG2030: only a row in this table does.
users.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.

sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: 14 sites in Prishtina: the Student Center and 13 physical education halls.
sites.name: Name
sites.missingGeo: Addresses and GPS coordinates are absent from every source document. They are not omitted here — they do not exist yet (GAPS 1 and 2), and the map module needs them.
sites.error_latLonTogether: Latitude and longitude go together — fill both or neither.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.intro: 36 buildings: 23 at the Student Center, 13 training venue halls.
buildings.name: Name
buildings.zoneNote: Zone applies to the Student Center only. The 13 training venue halls have none.
buildings.areaNote: Where net and gross areas differ markedly, both come from the sources and neither has been arbitrated (GAPS 17).
buildings.error_missingFields: Code, name and site are required.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.intro: 9 procurement procedures from the procurement plan.
contracts.name: Name
contracts.notApplicableDirect: Not applicable — direct contracting, so no notice is published
contracts.numberNote: The XX suffix is not yet assigned, so contract numbers are not unique. The functional key is the contract code (GAPS 19).
contracts.estimateNote: 8 of the 9 contracts are marked TBD in the procurement plan (GAPS 5).
contracts.numberFormatHint: Format: MYS/MG2030/{C|W|G|NC|DB}/{year}/XX. XX is accepted literally — the real suffix is not yet assigned.

lots.title: Lots
lots.name: Name
lots.unassignedNote: The split of the 13 training venue halls across the 4 works lots is not settled (GAPS 3). An unknown assignment is an absence of data, not an empty lot.
lots.error_minAboveMax: The minimum amount cannot be greater than the maximum.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: The overall schedule and the procurement schedule are the same object (brief §7). Durations are in calendar days; weeks = days / 7.
schedule.keyboardHint: Click or tab into a cell to edit. Enter validates and moves down, Tab validates and moves right, Escape cancels. There is no save button: validating a cell writes it and recalculates the downstream chain.
schedule.noPlanTooltip: No usable schedule for this scenario
schedule.driftNote: A gold dot marks a task whose stored dates differ from the recalculated ones. After the GAPS 12 correction the two coincide, so a drift means either an unsaved change or data touched outside the application.
schedule.driverProjectStart: Falls back to the project start date
schedule.invalidDuration: Duration must be a whole number of days, zero or more.
schedule.emptyActivity: The activity label cannot be empty.
schedule.unschedulableBody: This scenario is loaded without any task, on purpose. The source spreadsheet computes it backwards from the end of the Design & Build route, which puts works completion in October 2031, 21 months after the Games. No date has been invented to fill the gap (brief §7).
schedule.unschedulableFix: The procurement plan does contain a coherent timeline for this route: works from 27/03/2027 to 12/09/2029. What is missing is only the breakdown into tasks, which the PIU or the technical assistance can produce. See docs/GAPS.md, point 9.

gantt.title: Gantt
gantt.intro: Rendered in-house as SVG, with no dependency (see docs/GANTT_ARBITRAGE.md).
gantt.noTasks: No task to display for this scenario.

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.intro: Consultant reports and contractor deliverables. Lateness is derived at read time, never stored: a stored flag would be wrong the day after it was computed.
deliverables.wasLateNote: Submitted after the contractual date. The fact stays visible once the deliverable is in.
deliverables.lateCount: {count} deliverable(s) past their contractual date and not submitted.
deliverables.emptyNote: The register is empty because no deliverable appears in the source documents. It fills as the PIU and the technical assistance record what they receive (brief §3): consultants and contractors are not users of this platform.
deliverables.byContractIntro: What is open, what is late, and what comes next for each of the 9 procedures.

org.title: Org chart
org.intro: The 11 PIU functions plus the platform administrator, the technical assistance and the AFD task team. The sources contain no unit above the posts themselves, so this is a tree of posts (GAPS 28).
org.unfilledNote: Posts with no holder are normal at this stage: accounts are opened one by one by the administrator (see docs/ADMIN.md). The 14 on-site representatives in particular have no named assignment in any source (GAPS 29).

library.title: Library
library.intro: Files live in Cloudflare R2, never in Postgres. Uploads go straight from the browser to R2 — they never pass through a server function (brief §4).
library.noTagNote: A document with no tag is visible to every active MG2030 user (brief §7).
library.emptyFolder: No document in this folder yet
library.emptyNote: The library is empty because nothing has been uploaded yet. The folder tree comes from seed/folder_tree.csv and is a proposal, not project data.
library.treeIsProposal: This tree is a proposal (seed/folder_tree.csv). Administrators can reorganise it freely.
library.r2NotConfigured: Cloudflare R2 is not configured: the R2_* variables are missing from the environment. Browsing works, uploading does not. See .env.example.
library.error_forbidden: You do not have permission to upload documents.
library.error_r2_not_configured: Cloudflare R2 is not configured on this environment.
library.error_size_out_of_range: File is empty or larger than 5 GB.
library.error_mime_type_blocked: This file type is not accepted in the library.
library.error_folder_not_found: That folder does not exist, or you cannot access it.
library.error_upload_failed: The transfer to storage failed. Nothing was recorded.
library.error_orphan: The file reached storage but could not be recorded. Object key: {key} — pass it to an administrator so the orphan can be cleaned up.
